dedupe_keys.name: ribuild analysis of models for failure

description: RIBuild partners publish data used to assess models of building-material deterioration. KU Leuven, Università Politecnica delle Marche and RISE conducted laboratory tests associated with frost, algae and mould. DTU and Aalborg University used measurements from a WP3 setup to validate simulations of wood rot at embedded timber beam ends. Zenodo lists nineteen CSV and XLSX files, freely available under CC BY 4.0. The source defines a multi-part validation collection connecting measured conditions with selected failure mechanisms. A limitation is that the descriptive metadata does not enumerate all model equations, temporal coverage, sampling steps or accuracy results. The use of an existing WP3 experiment means that some underlying observations may overlap other RIBuild deposits; independent experimental replication is not claimed. The related DTU outdoor wall collection contains measurements and DELPHIN models, while this resource combines model-assessment evidence across several mechanisms and institutions.
